derivation: per attempt = (cofactor bits + bits(ell)) x (counted xDBL + xADD in F_(p^k)); minpoly = counted F_(p^k) inversion + 2k counted products + 2k^2 inner-product mults (and 2k^2 additions) + counted BM; expected find = 2 x per attempt + minpoly (R5.3's definition); *_by_a prices every addition at a M
unit: M = F_p mults+squarings (incl. schoolbook/Karatsuba coefficient products); W = word mults mod 62-bit NTT primes, counted as 1 M; I = F_p inversions; Meq = M + W + 91 I (R6.4's unit); A = F_p additions/subtractions/negations incl. fused schoolbook accumulations and the two u128 accumulations per NTT output coefficient; WA = additions/subtractions mod the NTT primes; cost(a) = Meq + a (A + WA)
